summary: Today's briefing highlights significant legal developments and business insights, particularly focusing on court rulings and market expansions in the retail sector.

bullets.text: Delhi Police stated Sonia Gandhi's name was on voters' list before she became an Indian citizen, as revealed in court.
Delhi High Court summoned IndianOil-Adani Gas official over missing affidavit from court records.
Karnataka High Court launched an RFID-based case file tracking system to enhance legal processes.
TechnoSport aims for Rs 1,000 crore revenue by FY27, up from nearly Rs 600 crore, with plans for 130 EBOs and 40 Express stores.
India's micro business credit market has expanded to Rs 29.6 lakh crore, indicating significant growth in the sector.
